map.Wh 是能量、跨电压可比；Ah 只表征电荷，不同电压不可直接比。选型与续航用 W: Wh is energy and comparable across voltages; Ah only measures charge and cannot be compared directly across voltages. Wh is more accurate for sizing and runtime.

map.：Wh=12×100=1200 Wh=1.2 kWh。若负载平均 50 W，理想: : Wh = 12 x 100 = 1200 Wh = 1.2 kWh. At an average load of 50 W the ideal runtime is about 1200/50 = 24 h (ignoring efficiency and depth of discharge). Tip: keep lithium battery discharge depth within 80% to extend life.
